candidates.excerpt: Mumbai police are investigating the tragic death of an 18-month-old girl in a Goregaon housing society. CCTV footage revealed a 10-year-old girl throwing the toddler down the stairwell from the sixth floor. The toddler was playing outside when her mother sent a brother to find her, leading to the grim discovery. Residents rushed the injured child to a doctor, but she was pronounced dead shortly after.
